title: 36 people who say they flew the craft (UFO Skyps book)
summary: Grant Cameron tells of 36 people who say they flew the craft (UFO Skyps book), about unspecified at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

Because I wrote the whole book on uh UFO sky pods where I write 36 people that mysteriously came to me and all said, "I've flown the craft."

tellings.link_reason: Same book and the same claim: 36 people came to Grant Cameron saying they had flown the craft.

as_told.title: UFO Sky Pods: 36 people who say they flew the craft

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says on Jesse Michels's podcast that he wrote a whole book, UFO Sky Pods, about 36 people who came to him, somewhat mysteriously, and each said they had flown one of the craft. If true, it would mean many ordinary people claim to have piloted these objects themselves.
